name: Crafted paper
Χάρτινη σύνθεση
description: Tactile paper worksites, records becoming data, and a shared digital system.
Χάρτινα εργοτάξια, αρχεία που γίνονται δεδομένα και ένα κοινό ψηφιακό σύστημα.
prompt: Create a premium conceptual portfolio cover for Aigistos, a custom ERP digitizing construction worksite operations. Square full-bleed image, no text, no logos, no letters or numbers. ART DIRECTION: sophisticated handcrafted layered cut-paper editorial illustration with visible paper fibres, precision folded edges and soft contact shadows, NOT plastic 3D, NOT an architectural maquette. Keep the tactile paper language of the reference, but replace the binder concept entirely. VISUAL STORY: physical construction work becomes structured digital information. On the upper left and across the middle are two crisply recognizable active construction worksites: unfinished concrete frame with scaffolding and a crane lifting a beam, plus a materials yard. Render all in beautifully cut chalk-white and sandstone paper. On the right, give a large unmistakable thin computer monitor and a smaller upright tablet a prominent role, both built from folded paper with dark glass-like inset screens. The monitor shows a clearly abstract digital operations interface: a tiny worksite map with location dots, tidy rows of status cells, several distinct record cards; white and jade shapes against dark teal, no text or numbers. Paper record slips and narrow amber/teal ribbons leave the physical sites and progressively break into precise small square data tiles that reassemble into the screen's orderly digital cards. Make the transition legible rather than decorative: site -> records becoming data -> shared screen. No central binder, folder, book, or planning table. Restrained deep teal, jade, chalk, warm stone and small amber accents. Composition feels like an exquisitely art-directed editorial paper sculpture, bold clear silhouettes, not busy diagram or generic tech icon collection. Essential worksite and computer screen occupy the central 75% and upper 70% so the image reads at small tile sizes. Bottom quarter is quiet uninterrupted deep teal textured paper for a title added later in HTML. No glowing holograms, cloud icons, robots, brains, padlocks or charts. This is an invented conceptual illustration, not an actual client worksite or application screenshot.

name: Editorial collage
Εκδοτικό κολάζ
description: Construction photo fragments connected to digital records on desktop and in the field.
Φωτογραφικά αποσπάσματα εργοταξίων συνδεδεμένα με ψηφιακά αρχεία στο γραφείο και στο πεδίο.
prompt: Create a sophisticated conceptual editorial collage portfolio cover for Aigistos, a custom ERP digitizing construction worksite operations. Square full bleed, NO text, logos, lettering, numbers or watermarks. ART DIRECTION: premium contemporary architecture-magazine photographic montage, precise cutout photographic fragments, subtle analogue grain, warm black-and-white photography selectively overprinted deep teal. Preserve the reference's confident editorial collage language, NOT paper sculpture, NOT a miniature or a 3D render. Change the core visual story to 'physical construction worksites become a connected digital operation'. On the left and upper center, bold photographic crops of a concrete structural frame with scaffolding, a working crane lifting materials, and stacked worksite supplies, composed as two or three large decisive overlapping planes. On the right foreground, a large sharply photographed thin desktop monitor with its visible base and a smaller upright field tablet: clearly recognizable real digital devices, not an ambiguous rectangular sheet. Dark screens with an abstract clean operations interface made from cream/jade rectangular record rows, small status blocks and a simplified site map with location dots, NO writing or numbers. This is deliberately conceptual invented UI, not a client screenshot. A narrow amber route from the physical construction fragments becomes a sparse sequence of small square data tiles crossing into the monitor and resolving into orderly digital record rows. Emphasize one readable relationship, construction operations captured in a shared digital system. No binder, folder, open book or central paper folio. Deep desaturated teal background, charcoal and warm chalk photographic tones, small restrained amber accent. Confident asymmetry, dramatic scale contrasts, exquisite cut edges, fine print texture, no noisy decorative grids or generic tech icon soup. Main scene occupies central 75% and upper 70%, with worksite structure and screen both immediately legible at thumbnail scale. Lower quarter remains quiet dark teal negative space for an HTML title. No people, holograms, neon, cloud icons, robots, brains, padlocks, or decorative graphs. Imagined conceptual artwork, not documentary photographs of the actual client's worksites.
